all.name: Sets and counting principles
all.description: Set notation, Venn diagrams, inclusion-exclusion and the rule of product.
objectives: use set notation for union, intersection and complement
visualize set operations with Venn diagrams
apply inclusion-exclusion to count elements
apply the rule of product to count outcomes

all.name: Independence of events
all.description: Defining and checking independence of events and its paradoxes.
objectives: state the definition of independent events
check whether two events are independent
explain why a probability-zero event is independent of itself

all.name: Random variables, pmf and cdf
all.description: Random variables as payoff functions and their probability mass and cumulative distribution functions.
objectives: define a discrete random variable on a sample space
write the pmf of a random variable
compute and graph a cdf
state properties of the cdf

all.name: Repeated updating and screening
all.description: Updating posteriors with successive data and revisiting the base rate fallacy.
objectives: use a posterior as the next prior
update on multiple data points at once
solve a screening test example with a Bayes table

all.name: Bayes tables: prior, likelihood, posterior
all.description: Introduces hypotheses, data, prior, likelihood and posterior in tabular Bayesian updating with discrete prior pmfs.
objectives: identify prior, likelihood and posterior in a problem
build a Bayes table for discrete hypotheses
compute posterior pmfs from prior pmfs
distinguish probabilities of data from probabilities of hypotheses

all.name: Conditional probability and multiplication rule
all.description: Defines conditional probability and derives the multiplication rule from it.
objectives: compute a conditional probability from the definition
apply the multiplication rule to find joint probabilities
interpret conditioning as restricting the sample space

all.name: Law of total probability, trees
all.description: Uses partitions of the sample space, urn models and trees to compute probabilities with the law of total probability.
objectives: state the law of total probability for a partition
compute probabilities in urn problems
organize conditional computations with a probability tree
distinguish shorthand and precise tree labels

all.name: Bayes' theorem and base rate fallacy
all.description: Introduces Bayes' theorem for inverting conditional probabilities and illustrates the base rate fallacy with screening tests.
objectives: state and derive Bayes' theorem
invert a conditional probability
explain the base rate fallacy
compute the probability of disease given a positive test

all.name: Bernoulli and binomial distributions
all.description: Defines Bernoulli and binomial distributions and explains where the binomial probabilities come from.
objectives: write the pmf of a Bernoulli random variable
model counts of successes with Binomial(n,p)
derive binomial probabilities using combinations
compute binomial probabilities

all.name: Geometric, uniform and other distributions
all.description: Covers the geometric and discrete uniform distributions and how to look up other named distributions.
objectives: model waiting times with a geometric distribution
compute geometric probabilities
describe the discrete uniform distribution
use resources to find other pmfs

all.name: Arithmetic with random variables
all.description: Shows how to add, multiply and transform random variables and count with sums of indicator variables.
objectives: compute the pmf of a sum of random variables
use indicator sums to count successes
find the distribution of a function of a random variable
